narrationTexts: All 12 files follow the identical 3-call pattern (get/list/update). I'll edit each one with the same three replacements.
All 12 app files edited. Let me verify no stragglers remain outside vendor.
finalText:
**Migration finished.** All 12 remaining files moved from `db.query` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files: `teamService.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `cohort.js`, `supplier.js`, `refund.js`, `couponService.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `shipment.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `returnService.js`, `session.js`.

One spot still uses `db.query`: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says it's a vendored file replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so I left it alone.

Next: decide how to handle `adapter.js` since it can't be edited in place. Maybe wrap it, patch on install, or accept `db.query` stays until upstream drops it.
